svg.title: Barista — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as barista, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A rounded portafilter with a long straight handle sits above a separate espresso cup and saucer. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, an oval face.
